decisions.reason: The decision changes I2C cable-length and series-resistor policy, not ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or GPIO availability.
The existing interboard connector types and SDA0/SCL0 pinout remain valid; optional series resistors and cable length are owned by the I2C electrical Requirement.
The source does not change component sourcing, availability, or cost policy.
The source permits either retaining or omitting the 22Ω SDA/SCL resistors but does not necessarily change the current BOM deliverable state.
The layout reference concerns optional I2C series resistors and does not alter battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or clearance.
The I2C resistor and cable decision does not affect the battery connector's series, pinout, pitch, or mounting type.
The source concerns 3.3V I2C signal conditioning, not the GPIO-switched 5V rail or its loads.
The conditional permission to remove resistors if they hinder layout does not change any established power-board dimensions, mounting, orientation, or enclosure constraints.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or 3.3V power-path topology.
The I2C cable and resistor policy does not affect the LED board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The sensor modules and their 3.3V interface remain unchanged; the source only modifies electrical conditioning of the shared I2C bus.
The source does not alter the standalone regulator, its activation condition, powered load, or source-selection topology.
